The PO must belong to the caller enterprise (tenant fence → 404); `idEnterprise` in the body is overwritten with the caller tenant. Guarded by the PO staleness gate when `expectedState` is sent (409). Writes an `order-started` audit entry. Blocked (403) for mirror tenants.

info.title: PackIOT Edge API
info.description:
REST API that bridges PackIOT factory edge devices, the CS Admin control plane and the product frontends with the core manufacturing database.

### Authentication
Every route under `/api/*` passes through `AuthMiddleware`, which accepts **one** of:

| Scheme | How | Who uses it |
|---|---|---|
| `x-api-key` | `x-api-key: <enterprise api_key>` header | factory boxes, Node-RED, integrations |
| `bearer` | `Authorization: Bearer <Cognito or Firebase ID token>` (when `AUTH_BEARER_ENABLED`) | front4, operator, csadmin |
| `token` | `?token=<api_key>` query string — **deprecated**, logged on every use | legacy clients |

The caller's enterprise is always derived **server-side** from the credential; a client-supplied `idEnterprise` is only honored for CS-Admin Bearer tokens (Cognito CS group) and verified operator super-admins (`x-operator-superadmin-token`).

**CS-Admin only** routes (enterprises, global translations, onboarding, edge bundle/SSM, Cognito users, Power BI) additionally require a CS-group Cognito Bearer and return **403** for api-keys and regular user tokens.

Public (no credential): `GET /`, `GET /health`, `GET /metrics`. The `/session*` family is outside `/api/*` but requires a Cognito ID token (`bearer`), verified by the session service itself.

### Conventions
- Mutations use `POST` (including deletes); reads use `GET`.
- Successful mutations are written to the `user_logs` audit trail (`res.locals.logData`).
- A `POST` carrying an `Idempotency-Key` header is de-duplicated by the global idempotency interceptor (mirror-worker replay contract).
- Errors use the envelope `{ statusCode, message, error? }` (see the `ErrorResponse` schema). Validation errors return the first message in `message` and all of them in `error`.

enabled.description: The current value of descriptor.onprem_offline for the tenant (absent ⇒ false).

Whether this client runs the on-prem fat-edge decode stack (ADR-0053 B-minimal: local agent + mosquitto + edge-transformer + local dashboard) for internet-outage tolerance. Drives (a) the reader tee — a second, best-effort POST to the on-box local agent — and (b) the client-bundle generator emitting the on-box compose. Stored as descriptor.onprem_offline.
The current value of descriptor.operator_edge for the tenant (absent ⇒ false).

Whether this client also runs the OPERATOR SPA on its factory box for offline floor operation (ADR-0054 edge-operator, Option A). Only meaningful for an onprem_offline tenant — the operator rides the fat-edge box. When true, deploy-onprem emits the operator-edge service into compose.onprem-edge.yml. Stored as descriptor.operator_edge.
The current value of descriptor.barcode_edge for the tenant (absent ⇒ false).

Whether this client also runs the BARCODE-SCANNER SPA on its factory box for offline scanning + label printing (task #230 edge-barcode). Only meaningful for an onprem_offline tenant — the SPA rides the fat-edge box. When true, deploy-onprem emits the barcode-edge service into compose.onprem-edge.yml. Stored as descriptor.barcode_edge.

exists.description: Whether the enterprise shell still exists.

protected.description: Whether this enterprise is on the protected denylist.

equipmentCount.description: Count of id_equipment tying telemetry to the tenant.

mode.description: reset = keep the enterprise shell + box (re-onboardable); remove = delete the tenant entirely.

dryRun.description: When true (DEFAULT), report the counts that WOULD be removed without deleting anything. A real delete must pass dryRun=false explicitly.

hard.description: HARD purge (DELETE) instead of soft-delete (active=false) on tables that support soft-delete. Gated behind the extra "hard purge" wall.

confirm.description: The typed confirmation token: the client slug (tenant_code) or the enterprise id as a string. REQUIRED on a real (dryRun=false) delete and must match the resolved tenant, or the call is refused. Ignored on a dry-run.

confirmBox.description: SECOND confirmation, ONLY for the box stage: the managed-instance id (mi-…) or the literal string "DELETE". REQUIRED on a real box teardown on top of `confirm` — the box is the most destructive, physical step.

token.description: A short-lived (~5 min) Superset guest token carrying an RLS clause scoped to the caller's server-derived enterprise. Hand it to @superset-ui/embedded-sdk fetchGuestToken().

dashboardUuid.description: The embed UUID the token was minted FOR — the language-appropriate dashboard variant (pt-BR vs English) the broker selected from the caller's `lang`. front4 must pass THIS to embedDashboard({ id }) so the iframe and the guest token reference the same dashboard.
